description: Exceptional architect apartment of 200 sqm in loft/duplex, located on the top floor, quiet and bright.The first level offers an extensive living room with fireplace and piano, a fully equipped kitchen as well as a large suite with bathroom.Upstairs you will find two additional bedrooms, two bathrooms and a second living room opening onto a beautiful sunny terrace overlooking the Eiffel Tower.MOBILITY LEASE ONLYThe spaceOn the ground floor, you will find a suite with a private bathtub and a queen-size bed measuring 160 × 200 cm.Upstairs, a bedroom with a private toilet and bathtub, equipped with a 160 × 200 cm queen-size bed.A second bedroom with a shower and private toilet, equipped with a 120 × 200 cm bed.Two additional beds are available in the relaxation area, with one bed measuring 120 × 200 cm and one bed measuring 90 × 185 cm.
